headline: Real Madrid Extends Midfielder Arda Guler Contract Until 2032
seoTitle: Real Madrid Extends Arda Guler Contract
metaDescription: Real Madrid has officially extended the contract of midfielder Arda Guler, securing the Turkish international's future with the club until June 2032.
aiSummaryBullets: Real Madrid has officially extended the contract for midfielder Arda Guler.
The new agreement secures the Turkish national team player's position at the club until June 30, 2032.
Guler expressed his pride and intention to follow in the footsteps of club legends via social media.
aiContextParagraph: Arda Guler, a professional footballer representing the Turkish national team, was originally recruited by Real Madrid from the Turkish club Fenerbahce. The Spanish football giants have now confirmed a long-term commitment to the player by extending his current contract. This new arrangement ensures that Guler remains with the Madrid-based organization for several seasons, with the deal reaching its conclusion in the summer of 2032. Following the official announcement by the club, Guler utilized his personal social media presence to voice his satisfaction with the development. He characterized the extension as a significant milestone in his professional career and expressed an ambition to contribute to the club's ongoing legacy, comparing his commitment to that of past influential players who have worn the Real Madrid uniform throughout the organization's history.
